_meta.purpose: Shared parity fixture for GurmukhiTransliterator (#84). Asserted by BOTH the Swift (ArdaasTests/GurmukhiTransliteratorTests.swift) and Kotlin (android/app/src/test/.../transliteration/GurmukhiTransliteratorTest.kt) suites, so the two engines cannot drift apart while each still passes its own tests.
_meta.sources: Expected values come from: every pair pinned by the Swift unit tests; every entry of the Swift exception lexicon; every bundled occasion's engine-generated Roman layer (occasions.json); and, for edge cases and every distinct word of the bundled Gurmukhi, the Kotlin port's output, verified against the Swift engine by iOS CI.
_meta.editing: Never change an expected value to make one platform pass: a failure here is a real divergence between the engines. If a rule change is intended, change both engines and regenerate the bundled Roman layers too.
